description:
BenchBox v0.1.0 installed from PyPI (wheel) cannot run TPC-H or TPC-DS benchmarks.
Query template files (.sql for TPC-H, .tpl for TPC-DS) live in `_sources/` at the
project root - outside the `benchbox/` package tree - and are never included in the
wheel. The pyproject.toml `[tool.setuptools.package-data]` `"*"` glob is ineffective
(patterns are relative to package dirs, not project root). MANIFEST.in correctly
includes them for sdist only.

Root cause: wheels don't use MANIFEST.in; only package-data matters. Since `_sources/`
is outside the package, setuptools cannot find the files.

Solution: Create shared `templates/` directories inside `benchbox/_binaries/tpc-{h,ds}/`
(already in the package tree and included in wheels). Update template resolution code
to look there first, with `_sources/` fallback for development.
